10. Briefly describe the effect of water pollution. Project work
1. Visit a nearby agricultural farmland and farmers and inquire about the various types of pesticides used there. Prepare a short report on it and discuss in class.
2. Make 3-4 groups of students with the help of your teacher and visit farmers of nearby farmland to survey on health hazards by the use of pesticides. Make report and discuss in class.
3. Prepare a power point presentation on pesticides of biological origin which are used locally and discuss. *****
